proposals.title: Bright facade window rhythm
proposals.change: Add a thin, warm-white unlit window-band proxy to the apartment midrise facade, with varied lit-window spacing.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a shallow additive plane offset from the facade; keep emissive intensity restrained and window coverage below 12 percent of visible facade area.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive bright detail avoids dark FOV materials and does not alter the frozen camera framing.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture City and Wide; confirm window bands remain thin, readable, and do not produce sun-like bloom or reduce any camera below Usable.

proposals.title: Warm tower parapet caps
proposals.change: Add narrow pale-stone parapet cap strips along the top edges of facade towers.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the authored cap geometry at x>=bx+3 and keep projection thickness minimal; use ivory plaster or light brick rather than metal.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The cap is a tiny behind-wall silhouette accent using a bright non-metal material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify no cap crosses the frozen FOV boundary and confirm City/Wide retain clear skyline separation without washout.

proposals.title: Corrugated facade rib cadence
proposals.change: Add three bright corrugated vertical ribs to one apartment or industrial facade section.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use sparse, light-gray ribs with alternating roughness; keep the section behind wall at x>=bx+3 and avoid full-facade repetition.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Localized behind-wall geometry adds bright vertical structure without introducing a dark sole FOV material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture City and check that ribs read as three separate facade edges without clipping, aliasing, or uniqueness collapse.

proposals.title: Facade drain downspout
proposals.change: Add one pale vertical drain downspout with two small elbows to a bright tower corner.
proposals.implementation_notes: Build as a narrow additive proxy with low luminance and a warm-gray tint; place only on a corner already visible in City.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The detail is narrow, additive, and bright enough to avoid black breakup while remaining below the hero-detail scale.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm the downspout is readable at capture resolution and adds no large bloom streak or camera occlusion.

proposals.title: Bright facade color-block patch
proposals.change: Add one muted terracotta color-block panel to a distant coast block facade.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single low-contrast rectangular patch behind wall at x>=bx+3; keep albedo above mid-gray and avoid repeating it on multiple buildings.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One small bright color cue improves facade separation without adding a hero stack or dark material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the patch remains localized, does not dominate the skyline, and keeps City/Wide Usable.

proposals.title: Crane counterweight safety stripe
proposals.change: Add a small yellow-and-white safety stripe to the harbor crane counterweight.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply a restrained additive stripe mask to the counterweight face; keep the stripe narrow and avoid red warning-light intensity.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A small bright additive marking gives the crane a clear color anchor without changing silhouette or exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Harbor and confirm stripe readability without bloom washout, silhouette loss, or reduced usability.

proposals.title: Crane cable sheave highlights
proposals.change: Add two small pale highlight rings to the visible crane cable sheaves.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use thin additive rings with low intensity and no animated spark behavior; limit the change to the two largest sheaves.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny additive rings improve circular feature recognition without introducing dark metal into the FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm both rings remain subpixel-to-small at capture distance and do not create circular glare artifacts.

proposals.title: Container corner castings
proposals.change: Add four pale corner-casting blocks to one visible container stack.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single stack behind wall at x>=bx+3 with light painted-metal material; keep castings shallow and confined to container corners.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Localized bright geometry adds industrial detail while remaining behind the capture wall and outside hero FOV risk.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify castings improve container segmentation in Harbor/Wide without adding excessive edge density or clipping.

proposals.title: Ship hull waterline stripe
proposals.change: Add a thin desaturated teal waterline stripe to the container ship hull.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply one narrow stripe below the main hull band, using a mid-bright teal that remains visibly lighter than the ocean.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The stripe is a restrained behind-wall color separator and prevents the hull from merging into a dark ocean read.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Harbor and Ocean; confirm hull and water remain separable with no pure-black final ocean region.

proposals.title: Freighter deck hatch line
proposals.change: Add one short pale deck-hatch outline to the freighter stern.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive rectangular outline on the existing deck plane; keep luminance below signage brightness and avoid stacked hatch patterns.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The single small additive outline improves deck readability without changing the ship silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm the hatch line is visible only as a small local accent and causes no glare or frame-wide exposure shift.

proposals.title: Pier bollard marker pair
proposals.change: Add two pale-yellow safety marker caps to the nearest pier bollards.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use small capped discs with low additive intensity; place them on two existing bollard positions and avoid adding new full bollard geometry.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny bright markers improve pier scale cues while keeping geometry and luminance tightly bounded.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify both caps read as markers, not lights, and Harbor remains Usable with no bloom washout.

proposals.title: Pier deck plank highlight
proposals.change: Add three short alternating warm-gray highlight strips across a pier deck section.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep strips thin, sparse, and behind wall at x>=bx+3; use rough warm-gray material with no glossy response.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse bright strips add local deck texture without dark PBR or large hero geometry.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm the strips do not form repetitive moire at capture resolution and do not alter Harbor usability.

proposals.title: Seawall capstone rhythm
proposals.change: Add five light concrete capstone seams along one seawall segment.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use shallow seam geometry or a masked unlit accent with even spacing; keep the seawall material light concrete and avoid deep black gaps.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Light concrete segmentation strengthens the seawall silhouette and avoids dark ocean-adjacent collapse.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Harbor/Ocean and verify seams remain thin, non-black, and free of repeating alias patterns.

proposals.title: Seawall tide-level markers
proposals.change: Add two small cyan tide-level marker dashes to the seawall face.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place two short low-intensity dashes near the waterline; use cyan-green rather than white to preserve contrast with foam.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive marks introduce controlled color variation without affecting ocean exposure or silhouette.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm markers remain small, do not read as navigational lights, and preserve Ocean usability.

proposals.title: Foam lace shoreline edge
proposals.change: Add a thin translucent-white foam lace line along one wet-sand shoreline contour.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a narrow additive ribbon with broken opacity, low intensity, and no large spray particles; keep it below the horizon and away from the main sky.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The foam is a thin local additive accent that brightens the shoreline without turning the ocean into a white wash.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Ocean/Wide and verify the foam reads as a broken shoreline edge with restrained bloom and no pure-black ocean finals.

proposals.title: Wet sand reflective patches
proposals.change: Add three small warm-gray wet-sand sheen patches near the shoreline.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use flat unlit HF patches with muted tan-gray values, low contrast, and irregular small masks; avoid glossy PBR reflections and keep them local to the sand.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The patches are restrained unlit HF detail, not dark PBR, and they add tonal continuity between foam and ocean.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify Ocean retains visible water color, patches do not become mirror highlights, and the camera remains Usable.

proposals.title: Tide-pool glint dots
proposals.change: Add a sparse set of four tiny cyan-white glint proxies inside shallow tide pools.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use four fixed low-intensity points with varied size and opacity; disable animation and keep total screen coverage minimal.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Fixed sparse emissive points provide controlled water detail without large foam or ocean luminance changes.
proposals.acceptance_test: Confirm glints remain pin-sized, do not twinkle or bloom excessively, and do not create black-to-white contrast collapse.

proposals.title: Submarine sail marker stripe
proposals.change: Add one narrow orange identification stripe to the visible submarine sail.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single subdued orange stripe on the sail, with brightness below a lamp and no additional submarine lights.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One small additive color cue improves silhouette recognition while avoiding an all-black submarine read.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture Ocean/Harbor and confirm stripe placement remains localized, non-glary, and does not obscure water separation.

proposals.title: Freighter bridge window band
proposals.change: Add a short pale-blue bridge-window band to the freighter superstructure.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single thin masked band with varied opacity and cool blue-white values; keep it below the intensity of navigation lighting.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A narrow additive window band adds ship identity without introducing dark material or a large hero stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: Verify the band reads as windows at capture resolution, has no excessive bloom, and Harbor remains Usable.

proposals.title: Coast-block roof vent caps
proposals.change: Add two small light roof vent caps to a distant coast block.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place two compact bright vent caps behind wall at x>=bx+3; use painted concrete or pale plaster and keep them below the skyline focal line.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small bright rooftop accents add city scale without affecting the frozen foreground composition or exposure.
proposals.acceptance_test: Capture City/Wide and confirm both caps remain subtle, do not clip the skyline, and preserve 11/11 camera usability.
